name: Summary Calculation
query:
SELECT
    i.custom_internal_model AS "内部机种::120",
    i.custom_external_model AS "外部型号::180",
    COALESCE(fgs.sold_qty, 0) AS "销售品:Int:90",
    COALESCE(stock.stock_qty, 0) AS "库存品:Float:90",
    COALESCE(fgs.sample_qty, 0) AS "样品:Int:80",
    COALESCE(loan_out.loan_qty, 0) AS "借出样品:Float:100",
    COALESCE(loan_in.loan_qty, 0) AS "借回样品:Float:100",
    COALESCE(wip.wip_qty, 0) AS "在制品:Float:90",
    COALESCE(fgs.sold_qty, 0) + COALESCE(stock.stock_qty, 0) + COALESCE(fgs.sample_qty, 0) + COALESCE(loan_out.loan_qty, 0) + COALESCE(loan_in.loan_qty, 0) + COALESCE(wip.wip_qty, 0) AS "总计数量:Float:100",
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(stock.stock_qty, 0) + COALESCE(loan_out.loan_qty, 0) + COALESCE(wip.wip_qty, 0) > 0 THEN '有库存' ELSE '无库存' END AS "状态::90",
    NULL AS "备注::180"
FROM `tabItem` i
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT item_code,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = '销售品' THEN in_qty ELSE 0 END) AS sold_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = '样品' THEN in_qty ELSE 0 END) AS sample_qty
    FROM `tabFinished Goods Status` fgs_row
    LEFT JOIN `tabWarehouse` fgs_warehouse ON fgs_warehouse.name = fgs_row.warehouse
    WHERE (COALESCE(%(company)s, '') = '' OR fgs_warehouse.company = %(company)s)
    GROUP BY item_code
) fgs ON fgs.item_code = i.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT item_code, SUM(actual_qty) AS stock_qty
    FROM `tabBin` b
    INNER JOIN `tabWarehouse` stock_warehouse ON stock_warehouse.name = b.warehouse
    WHERE (COALESCE(%(company)s, '') = '' OR stock_warehouse.company = %(company)s)
    GROUP BY item_code
) stock ON stock.item_code = i.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT item_code, COUNT(*) AS loan_qty
    FROM `tabSample Loan Out Item` loi
    INNER JOIN `tabSample Loan Out` lo ON lo.name = loi.parent
    WHERE lo.docstatus = 1 AND IFNULL(loi.returned, 0) = 0
      AND (COALESCE(%(company)s, '') = '' OR lo.company = %(company)s)
    GROUP BY item_code
) loan_out ON loan_out.item_code = i.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT lii.item_code, SUM(GREATEST(lii.qty - IFNULL(lii.returned_qty, 0), 0)) AS loan_qty
    FROM `tabSample Loan In Item` lii
    INNER JOIN `tabSample Loan In` li ON li.name = lii.parent
    WHERE li.docstatus = 1 AND GREATEST(lii.qty - IFNULL(lii.returned_qty, 0), 0) > 0
      AND (COALESCE(%(company)s, '') = '' OR li.company = %(company)s)
    GROUP BY lii.item_code
) loan_in ON loan_in.item_code = i.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT production_item AS item_code, SUM(GREATEST(qty - IFNULL(produced_qty, 0), 0)) AS wip_qty
    FROM `tabWork Order`
    WHERE docstatus = 1 AND status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Stopped', 'Cancelled')
      AND (COALESCE(%(company)s, '') = '' OR company = %(company)s)
    GROUP BY production_item
) wip ON wip.item_code = i.name
WHERE i.disabled = 0
  AND (COALESCE(%(internal_model)s, '') = '' OR i.custom_internal_model LIKE CONCAT(CHAR(37), %(internal_model)s, CHAR(37)))
  AND (COALESCE(%(external_model)s, '') = '' OR i.custom_external_model LIKE CONCAT(CHAR(37), %(external_model)s, CHAR(37)))
  AND (COALESCE(fgs.sold_qty, 0) + COALESCE(stock.stock_qty, 0) + COALESCE(fgs.sample_qty, 0) + COALESCE(loan_out.loan_qty, 0) + COALESCE(loan_in.loan_qty, 0) + COALESCE(wip.wip_qty, 0)) <> 0
ORDER BY i.custom_internal_model, i.custom_external_model
